verdict.rationale: Smithery's docs mention that a server's page lets users 'discover, try, and install' an MCP from any client, implying some in-browser trial capability, but there is no explicit description of a dedicated inspector/playground UI for exercising tools before integration — the closest concrete tool-calling evidence is a CLI (`smithery tool call`), not browser-based. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or screenshots of a browser-based inspector/playground, hands-on confirmation of trying tools in-browser, and detail on what 'try' actually entails.
